payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear definition and context for Masked Document Generation (MDG) as a task in pre-training seq2seq models for document summarization.

claims.text: Masked Document Generation (MDG) is a task that learns to recover a document with a masked span of tokens, where a span of text is randomly selected and masked to train the model to predict the original text.
MDG is one of three pre-training tasks designed to improve the performance of seq2seq models in abstractive summarization, alongside Sentence Reordering and Next Sentence Generation.
